reason: In the patched loadUsers (handleNewBooking.ts:710-763), an empty dynamicUserList throws a plain Error that the catch turns into a generic 500 "Unable to load users". Prisma known-request errors are re-thrown as 400 with the raw message, other errors lose their message and become that generic 500, and the `organization: { select: { slug } }` select is gone even though IsFixedAwareUser (line 355) still declares `organization: { slug: string }`. One detail is overstated: before the patch an empty list did not clearly reach the 404 at lines 781-798, and nothing in this file reads organization.slug.
